description: Festival dates whose engine value equals the date printed by Drik Panchang for the reference city of the tradition (Delhi = Purnimanta, Chennai = Amanta). Key = slug|year|tradition|date. Generated by scripts/build-verified-dates.ts from reference/festivals; the app shows "verified against Drik Panchang on <fetchedAt>" only when its computed date equals `date`, else "not yet verified".
